title: Service owners
description: Who owns each service, edited in place and joined to open investigations with ES|QL LOOKUP JOIN.

body.text: The owner of record for each service, kept in the `service_owners` lookup index. Click a service to change its owner.

children.title: Critical tier
children.query: FROM service_owners | WHERE tier == "critical" | STATS critical = COUNT(*)

children.title: Services in open investigations with no owner
children.query: FROM nightshift-app-investigations | WHERE status == "open" | GROK title "(?<service.name>[a-z]+-(service|gateway|frontend|processors|processing|manager))" | EVAL service.name = CASE(entities == "", service.name, SPLIT(REPLACE(entities, ", ", ","), ",")) | MV_EXPAND service.name | WHERE service.name IS NOT NULL | STATS open_investigations = COUNT(*) BY service.name | LOOKUP JOIN service_owners ON service.name | STATS unowned = COUNT(*) WHERE team IS NULL

FROM service_owners | EVAL team = COALESCE(team, ""), slack_channel = COALESCE(slack_channel, ""), tier = COALESCE(tier, ""), runbook_url = COALESCE(runbook_url, "") | KEEP service.name, team, tier, slack_channel, runbook_url, updated_at | SORT service.name | LIMIT 200

FROM nightshift-app-investigations | WHERE status == "open" | GROK title "(?<service.name>[a-z]+-(service|gateway|frontend|processors|processing|manager))" | EVAL service.name = CASE(entities == "", service.name, SPLIT(REPLACE(entities, ", ", ","), ",")) | MV_EXPAND service.name | WHERE service.name IS NOT NULL | STATS open_investigations = COUNT(*), critical = COUNT(*) WHERE severity == "critical" BY service.name | LOOKUP JOIN service_owners ON service.name | EVAL owner = COALESCE(team, "No owner"), tier = COALESCE(tier, "unknown"), slack_channel = COALESCE(slack_channel, "") | KEEP service.name, owner, tier, slack_channel, open_investigations, critical | SORT critical DESC, open_investigations DESC, service.name

children.text: Give a service an owner. Use the name the service reports as `service.name`, such as `order-processing`.
